profiles: Signed to Hospital in 2010; explore the shift from Cross the Line to Zeitgeist, then the orchestral Red Bull Symphonic project.
Firestarter’s crossover sound and its later Andy C remix provide an entry point into their catalogue.
Gold Dust appeared in several versions; the 2012 Shy FX re-edit reached number 22 in the UK.
The label’s retrospective places Source Direct among artists associated with the 1990s Speed club scene.

Compare the debut album and Untrue, both released through Hyperdub. The latter’s anniversary edition uses a stripped-back version of Burial’s original hand-drawn artwork. Begin with Archangel, then compare the texture and atmosphere of Near Dark.

Sam Shepherd released Elaenia in 2015, and Crush followed on Ninja Tune in 2019. The label describes a shift toward a more immediate, improvisation-led recording process using a Buchla synthesizer, following solo sets supporting The xx in 2017.
The Brain project debuted on Planet E in 2020. Its 2026 remaster offers a starting point for exploring Dear’s other projects, including Audion, False and Jabberjaw.
Co-founder of Arms & Legs alongside Daniel Steinberg. Explore The Dust and the label’s house and techno catalogue.
Saul Milton and Will Kennard charted with Love’s Theme in 2005, reached the UK album top two with No More Idols and earned their first singles chart number one with BACKBONE in 2024.
Nu:Tone and Logistics formed the collaborative project Nu:Logic. Their debut album in 2013 was revisited in a 2023 anniversary remix EP.

dusky-bindweed.title: Bindweed (Limonata Mix)
dusky-bindweed.artistContext: London duo Nick Harriman and Alfie Granger-Howell have released house, techno and melodic club music across several labels, including Anjunadeep.
dusky-bindweed.releaseContext: The Limonata version revisits music from Signals. The release includes original arrangements and extended versions, allowing a comparison of the same musical material in different formats.
dusky-bindweed.listenFor: Compare the 3:33 mix with the 4:54 extended mix: where does the longer arrangement give a DJ room to transition?

onho-entropic.title: Entropic Voltage
onho-entropic.artistContext: Onho also works with Ness under the name Purpurea, whose debut E.F.S. appeared on The Gods Planet.
onho-entropic.releaseContext: Four pieces of deep techno make up this EP. The title track runs for 6:46; Audio Sol is credited with mastering.
onho-entropic.listenFor: Compare the title track with Nonlinear Pulse, focusing on how repeated motifs build tension.

pursefurst-pimp.title: PIMP
pursefurst-pimp.artistContext: PurseFurst is a Miami-based DJ and producer; coverage of this Desolat EP highlights its hip-hop influence.
pursefurst-pimp.releaseContext: Desolat presents two tracks: PIMP (5:52) and CHECKUP (4:14). This is the Bandcamp edition; other stores may list an earlier release date.
pursefurst-pimp.listenFor: Compare how the two arrangements use space between percussion and vocal elements.

kenlai-eclipse.title: Eclipse
kenlai-eclipse.artistContext: Kenlai is the project of Mexican DJ and producer Iván Cruz Gutiérrez. The release page identifies him as born in Mexico City and based in Nayarit.
kenlai-eclipse.releaseContext: Subnautique presents Eclipse as a two-track project bringing a chapter to a close, with house and downtempo elements.
kenlai-eclipse.listenFor: Listen for the relationship between melody and rhythmic movement across both tracks.

anteac-lights.title: ANTEAC - DYNAMIC LIGHTS
anteac-lights.artistContext: Anteac is an underground DJ and producer based in Barcelona, according to the artist’s Beatport profile.
anteac-lights.releaseContext: Xelima Records lists three cuts, including dynamic lights (4:57) and another version (4:37). Its release tags connect breakbeat, electro and minimal techno.
anteac-lights.listenFor: Compare the drum placement and use of repetition across the versions.

zinc-motive-extended.title: Motive (Extended Mix)
zinc-motive-extended.artistContext: London producer DJ Zinc has worked across jungle, drum & bass, breaks and garage. His cross-tempo record 138 Trek helped lead to the Bingo Beats label.
zinc-motive-extended.releaseContext: Zinc identifies the Bandcamp release as the extended version of Motive, with the radio edit available on streaming platforms.
zinc-motive-extended.listenFor: Compare the extended introduction and outro with the radio edit, where available.

siwotha-fall.title: NACH DEM FALL
siwotha-fall.artistContext: Sonaxx describes this as a collaboration between French artist Siwotha You and German vocalist Luna Sage.
siwotha-fall.releaseContext: The label credits Luna Sage on the 5:42 title track; the second cut is Every last Promise (4:20).
siwotha-fall.listenFor: Explore how the vocal is positioned against the intense schranz rhythm, and compare with the second cut.

hedust-ketacid.title: Ketacid
hedust-ketacid.artistContext: HedustMA and NBS000 are the two credited collaborators on this Ovnimoon Records release. Further independent biographical details have not yet been verified.
hedust-ketacid.releaseContext: The label places Ketacid at the intersection of acid techno and psychedelic electronic music.
hedust-ketacid.listenFor: Listen for changes in the acid-style bass and rhythmic texture; this is a listening prompt, not a measured analysis.

mqrot-sampler.title: Future Is Coming (2025 - 2026 Sampler)
mqrot-sampler.artistContext: This is a multi-artist compilation curated by MQROT Records, rather than a release by one individual performer.
mqrot-sampler.releaseContext: The label describes the collection as a selection of tracks from 2025–2026, drawing together EBM, electro and industrial music.
mqrot-sampler.listenFor: Choose two contrasting tracks from the official tracklist and compare their rhythmic character.

physics-invisible-prvail.title: Invisible Line (PRVAIL Remix)
physics-invisible-prvail.artistContext: Physics founded Midnight Sun Recordings and has been active in Finland’s drum & bass scene. PRVAIL is credited as the remixer.
physics-invisible-prvail.releaseContext: The label describes this as a new interpretation of the February 2026 original, contrasting atmospheric material with modern techstep influences.
physics-invisible-prvail.listenFor: Compare the original and remix for changes in bass movement, percussion and atmosphere.
